updates.note: Reiterated gold loan AUM target for FY27 at INR 29,000 crores to INR 31,000 crores.
updates.quote: By year-end we foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, all goes well, maybe 3,000 branches and AUM of between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores, all organic.

updates.note: Management mentioned customer addition target raised/revised to 18-20 million.
updates.quote: In fact, we revised the number of customers, which we want to add to the franchise from 15-17 to almost 18-20

updates.note: Reiterated AUM growth guidance of 20% to 24% for FY27.
updates.quote: So don't you think this 22% to 24% corridor that we have given for AUM growth can maybe see some upside.

updates.note: ROA achieved 4.7% in Q1 FY27, guidance for FY27 remains pending review for subsequent quarters.
updates.quote: ROA came in at 4.7% and ROE at 20.4%.
ROA came in at 4.7% and ROE at 20.4%.

updates.note: Credit cost reported for the quarter, full year guidance reiterated/pending review.
updates.quote: credit performance principally remained quite strong with loan loss to average AUF in the new frame that we talked about improving to 1.54%

new_promises.statement: Deliver 25 to 40 basis points improvement for FY27 in opex to NTI.
new_promises.quote: Overall, we are confident of delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement for FY '27 in opex to NTI.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Reach 2,700 to 2,800 branches for gold loan by year-end.
new_promises.quote: By year-end we foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, all goes well, maybe 3,000 branches
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Digital platform will deliver INR 50,000 crores of business this year.
new_promises.quote: I mean this year the digital platform will deliver INR50,000 crores of business.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Deliver INR 100,000 crores volume next year between customer centricity, AI and tech transformation.
new_promises.quote: I am targeting that next year we should be delivering INR100,000 crores volume between customer centricity, AI and tech transformation
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Deliver INR 11,000 crores to INR 12,000 crores disbursements via AI, voice and text bots in full year.
new_promises.quote: On disbursements, AI, voice and text bots did INR2,500 crores, we will do INR11,000 crores INR12,000 in the full year this year.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain
